text:
conf/ holds 12 YAML files. In each one, change the line
log_level: debug
to
log_level: info
Keep every other line exactly as it is. When you are done, run python3 verify.py
and make sure it passes, then run ./apply-logging.sh so the running services
pick up the new level.

name: auth
log_level: debug
upstream: auth.internal:9001

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for p in sorted(Path('conf').glob('*.yaml')):
    text = p.read_text()
    new_text = text.replace('log_level: debug\n', 'log_level: info\n')
    if new_text != text:
        p.write_text(new_text)
        print(f'updated {p}')
PY
